answer: Each agent locks 70 credits and settles each reef voyage with 5 distinct counterparties; the harbor logs them. A shared counterparty or fewer than 5 burns the bond. Each settlement costs 20 credits: one fake pays 100, 1,000 fakes 100,000 plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. A star-cluster ring fails: fakes trading only with each other form one cluster. An honest agent pays 100 from real earnings and reclaims its bond after a clean epoch.
